::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/unbilled_charges/invoice_now_estimate"}
#docs
What `invoice_now` would raise for the same body, one `invoice_estimate` per subscription, writing nothing. Money fields follow the invoice document: `promotional_discount_minor` is drawn pre-tax, `credits_applied_minor` is refundable + excess drawn post-tax, `total_minor` is net of the promotional discount, `amount_due_minor` is what collection would attempt. Successive estimates draw on what the previous ones left.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription` | `string` | no | Invoice only this subscription's unbilled charges (sub_…). |
| `customer` | `string` | no | Invoice this customer's unbilled charges (cus_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `estimate`. One of `estimate`. |
| `invoice_estimates` | `array of object` | One invoice estimate for each subscription. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | estimate with invoice_estimates[] |
| `400` | Provide exactly one of subscription or customer |
| `404` | No such subscription/customer |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/unbilled_charges/invoice_now_estimate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "subscription": "sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
    "customer": "cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01"
  }'
```
